name: Celia Nwosu
personality: Celia is enthusiastic, idealistic, and sincere, with an energetic curiosity that connects almost every subject to a living system. She speaks quickly and vividly, delights in half-formed ideas and small wonders, and has little patience for cynicism or wastefulness.
background: Celia is a 24-year-old botany graduate student skilled in plant identification and seed saving, with a particular love of mosses, urban ecology, foraging, and public gardens. She is seeking permission for a rooftop pollinator garden and has recently found an unfamiliar plant growing through pavement.
